text: As the subject location is classified as a major arterial road, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is recommending a reduction of the 50 km/h speed limit to a 40 km/h speed limit on Yonge Street, between Sheppard Avenue East/West and Finch Avenue East/West in conjunction with the duration of the Café TO program. The proposed speed limit reduction within the Café TO area will provide a means of enforcement while promoting reduced travel speed and provide a safer environment for all road users

City Council on June 8 and 9, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council reduce the speed limit from 50 kilometres per hour to 40 kilometres per hour on Yonge Street, between Sheppard Avenue East/West and Finch Avenue East/West.
